overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Kaskinen 6 Person Hybrid Outdoor Sauna with PureTech™ Full Spectrum IR or Traditional Stove offers a luxurious and versatile wellness retreat right in your backyard. Designed for outdoor use, this sauna combines the benefits of a traditional stove with the advanced technology of 15 IR emitters, including 7 Carbon PureTech™ Near Zero EMF heating panels, to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Its elegant Vanilla Crème exterior and Canadian Red Cedar interior create a serene environment, enhanced by a galaxy star color therapy lighting system and built-in Bluetooth speakers for a truly immersive experience. Ideal for those seeking a comprehensive spa-like escape, this sauna is perfect for enhancing your outdoor living space.

Even where space is at a premium, you can still enjoy the good life in the form of a delightfully relaxing and invigorating steam sauna in the comfort of your own home.
Our Barn Series brings even more relaxation with an all-natural Canadian Red Cedar interior finish, providing an invigorating rich aroma to your sauna session.

Golden Designs outdoor Hybrid (Traditional Stove or Full Spectrum Infrared) saunas provides a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional or full spectrum infrared sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!!
